idea: AgentSIM is designed to give you control of a personal NEAR AI agent from your phone, with the owner's P-256 signing key protected by a compatible, provisioned SIM or eSIM and authorized phone access. The owner approves spending without carrying another signing device. The cloud model proposes a payment, the owner signs the permission, and the NEAR vault enforces its limits. You choose the recipient, per-payment limit, total budget and expiry, and can revoke the grant. A separate Ed25519 agent key signs each spend and a restricted relayer submits it. On November 14, 2026, the project owner confirmed signing on a physical SIM. A live NEAR AI response drove a controlled local NEAR run that transferred 0.001 test NEAR and completed its callback. Four forbidden relay actions, overspending and a post-revocation payment were rejected. The phone approval interface has not shipped. The first commercial SIM dates to 1991. GSMA's 2026 figures are 8.8 billion wireless connections and 5.8 billion unique subscribers, not a count of compatible cards.
